test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Exclusion
solution:
The correct answer is **"Admittance"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Admittance"** is the most appropriate antonym of **"Exclusion"**.
 
• We used the word** "Exclusion" **to mean -" to prevent or restrict the entrance of".
 
• While the meaning of **"Admittance"** is "being allowed to enter a place".
 
• Thus, ***option 4)*** is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us understand the meaning of other options as well.

 
• **Discharge: **to send something out (a liquid, gas, etc.).

 
 
• **Example: **The **discharge** of water from the reservoirs caused flood in the village.
 
 
 
• **Commotion: **noisy confusion
 
 
• **Example: **The death of the political leader cased a great** commotion **in the city.
 
 
 
• **Wreck: **to destroy or badly damage something
 
 
• **Example:** The explosion **wrecked** one house and shattered nearby windows.
